minutes_model_note: roster/blend ratings are priced with the Depth Chart allocator (the fitted rotation curve blended into each man's own expected minutes at depth_chart_w, then renormalized to 240) -- the same allocator contract.features declares as depth_chart_minutes, so a locally recomputed 'before + delta' matches the shipped 'after'.
nightly_movers_note: movers: the gap between a team's nightly read and the SAME team priced off its season-typical minutes, split one piece per player -- who has stopped playing, who is back, who is up or down on minutes. delta_pts is points a game BEFORE the mix with the season-long rating (multiply by 1 - results_w for the share that reaches the nightly number itself). The listed men are the biggest 3; n_movers_total counts everyone worth at least 0.01 of a point a game, and delta_pre_mix is the whole team's gap, which the FULL decomposition sums to exactly. nightly_league_typical_shift is how much the 30-team average moved between the two readings -- a league-wide level that is nobody's fault and is deliberately NOT charged to any player.
nightly_note: who has actually been on the floor: each team's last 10 real games of 2025-26, re-priced from the men who played them and mixed with the season-long results rating. contract.features declares nightly_strength, so this is the site's preferred read for pricing a game.
off_def_note: off - def is each team's margin rating; off + def is how many points it adds to a game's TOTAL vs an average team. Since 2026-08-21 all three rating families (results/roster/blend) carry a genuine offense/defense split -- roster/blend used to be off=+net/2, def=-net/2, i.e. off+def was exactly 0 for every team and the engine projected an identical total for every matchup. contract.features declares split_off_def: the receiver prices a roster EDIT per side too, from each player's own value_off_per36/value_def_per36, instead of halving his net.
